children.value: > Fact From Story: Epic sued Google in 2020 after a fight over in-app purchase fees
> > Fact From Story: Epic wants to break up Google’s alleged monopoly on Android app stores and payment methods, so developers aren’t stuck paying the “Google Tax” or passing | Fact From Story

> > > Fact From Story: Epic was ready and waiting with two lawsuits and an attack ad, depicting a Fortnite hero throwing a unicorn-llama hammer into a giant screen reminiscent of Apple’s famous “1984” Macintosh ad. | Fact From Story
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Companies can sue each other. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge: A monopoly is when a company dominates a market and restricts competition. | Commonsense Knowledge
> Fact From Story: Fortnite publisher Epic Games is suing Google, claiming the Android operating system’s Google Play Store constituted an unlawful monopoly
> Commonsense Knowledge: When a company sues another company, it is called a trial.
